tools.name: id_iban
tools.description: IBAN validator (batch of 100) ($0.001 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Validates IBANs: country, ISO 13616 length for 90 countries, mod-97 check digits, SEPA membership, print format and bank/branch/account split for GB, IE, DE, NL, FR, ES, IT. Up to 100 per call. Duo Data charges $0.05 per IBAN. H

tools.name: id_gs1
tools.description: EAN/UPC/GTIN/ISBN check-digit validator ($0.001 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). EAN-8, UPC-A, EAN-13, GTIN-14 and ISBN-10/13: type, check digit, expected digit, GTIN-14 form, ISBN-10<->13 conversion, GS1 prefix. Up to 100 per call. Duo Data charges $0.05. HTTP POST https://mpp-utils.fmf-x402.worke

tools.name: id_security
tools.description: ISIN / CUSIP / SEDOL / FIGI validator ($0.001 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Detects and validates securities identifiers (ISIN Luhn, CUSIP and SEDOL weighted check digits, FIGI), with embedded CUSIP for US/CA ISINs. Up to 100 per call. Duo Data charges $0.05. HTTP POST https://mpp-utils.fmf-x402

tools.name: id_card
tools.description: Payment card number check (Luhn + brand) ($0.001 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Luhn check, brand (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover, JCB, Diners, UnionPay, Maestro), length validity and BIN prefix for up to 100 numbers. Numbers are never stored or echoed: only the last 4 come back. HTTP POST http

tools.name: chain_address
tools.description: Crypto address validator (EVM, BTC, SOL, TRON, LTC, DOGE) ($0.001 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Detects the chain and verifies checksums: EIP-55 for EVM (returns the checksummed form), Base58Check and bech32/bech32m for Bitcoin (p2pkh, p2sh, p2wpkh, p2wsh, p2tr; mainnet/testnet), Tron, Litecoin,

tools.name: code_jwt
tools.description: JWT decoder ($0.001 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Decodes a JWT/JWS: header (alg, kid, typ), claims, issued/not-before/expiry as ISO times, expired flag and seconds left. Optional HS256/384/512 signature check when you pass the shared secret. Nothing is stored. HTTP POST https://mpp-utils.fmf-x4

tools.name: code_hash
tools.description: Hash / HMAC generator ($0.001 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256/384/512, SHA3-256/512, Keccak-256 (Ethereum), BLAKE2b, BLAKE3 and CRC32 of text, hex or base64 input (up to 1 MB), optional HMAC key; hex and base64 output. Pass algorithms[] or get them all. HTTP POST https://mpp-ut

tools.name: code_semver
tools.description: Semver parse / compare / range check ($0.001 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Parse versions, sort a list, test range satisfaction (npm ranges: ^, ~, x, ||, hyphen), find the max/min satisfying version, diff type (major/minor/patch) and coercion of loose strings like "v2.3". HTTP POST https://mpp-u

tools.name: code_url
tools.description: URL parser + registrable domain (Public Suffix List) ($0.001 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). tools.name: text_similarity
tools.description: String similarity (Levenshtein, Jaro-Winkler, Soundex) ($0.001 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Compare a string to up to 500 candidates: Levenshtein distance and ratio, Jaro-Winkler, token-set overlap, Soundex match; ranked best-first. For fuzzy matching names, dedupe and record linkage. Duo Data

tools.name: text_slug
tools.description: URL slug generator (with transliteration) ($0.001 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Unicode-aware slugs for up to 100 strings: strips accents, transliterates German, Nordic, Cyrillic and Greek letters, & -> and, custom separator and max length. Duo Data charges $0.05. HTTP POST https://mpp-utils.fmf

tools.name: geo_distance
tools.description: Geodesic distance, bearing, midpoint + geohash ($0.001 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). WGS-84 ellipsoidal (Vincenty) and great-circle distance in m/km/mi/nmi, initial and final bearing, midpoint, from a point to up to 100 others (sorted nearest-first). tools.name: time_cron
tools.description: Cron expression: next/previous run times ($0.001 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Validates 5/6-field cron (and @daily, L, W, #) and returns the next (or previous) N run times in any IANA timezone with UTC and local ISO strings, plus a plain-English-ish field breakdown. HTTP POST https://mpp-utils.

tools.name: time_rrule
tools.description: RFC 5545 RRULE expander ($0.001 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Expands an iCalendar recurrence rule (RRULE/DTSTART, e.g. FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=-1FR) into concrete dates (up to 500), with between/after filters and a human-readable description. Duo Data charges $0.05. HTTP POST https://mpp-utils.fmf-x

tools.name: time_business_days
tools.description: Business days: add or count ($0.001 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Count working days between two dates or add/subtract N business days, with custom weekend (default Sat/Sun) and a holiday list you pass. Returns the result date and the skipped holidays/weekends. Duo Data charges $0.05. HTTP POST

tools.name: time_convert
tools.description: Time zone converter ($0.001 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Convert an instant (ISO, unix seconds/ms, or a local wall time + from_tz) into up to 50 IANA zones: local ISO time, weekday, UTC offset, abbreviation, plus unix seconds. DST-aware. HTTP POST https://mpp-utils.fmf-x402.workers.dev/time/con

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: id_iban, id_gs1, id_security, id_card, code_jwt, code_hash, code_semver, code_url, time_business_days · Private data: code_jwt, text_similarity · Public sink: id_iban, id_gs1, id_security, id_card, chain_address, code_jwt, code_hash, code_semver, code_url, text_similarity, text_slug, geo_distance, time_cron, time_rrule, time_business_days, time_convert, id_uuid, data_csv_to_json, data_json_to_csv · Destructive: id_iban, time_cron.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: id_iban, id_gs1, id_security, id_card, code_jwt, code_hash, code_semver, code_url, time_business_days · Private data: code_jwt, text_similarity · Public sink: id_iban, id_gs1, id_security, id_card, chain_address, code_jwt, code_hash, code_semver, code_url, text_similarity, text_slug, geo_distance, time_cron, time_rrule, time_business_days, time_convert, id_uuid, data_csv_to_json, data_json_to_csv · Destructive: id_iban, time_cron

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
